### Fixed
- `AgentgatewayParameters` renders the Service-type overlay at `spec.service.spec.type`, the path the CRD declares (an embedded `ServiceSpec` under `spec.service.spec`), instead of `spec.service.type`, which is not in the schema. Until now the overlay never took effect: helm-controller's client-side apply silently pruned the unknown field, so the agentgateway data-plane Service stayed at the controller-hardcoded `LoadBalancer`; under Helm 4's default server-side apply the same field made the install hard-fail (`.spec.service.type: field not declared in schema`). **Visible rollout effect:** on installations running an `agentgateway-*` ingress mode without the chart-owned edge, the data-plane Service now actually becomes `gateway.parameters.serviceType` (default `ClusterIP`, the intended state — the front Gateway serves public traffic), which **deletes the unintended cloud LoadBalancer** that the pruned overlay left behind. Edge-mode installs (`gatewayApi.gateway.create: true`) keep `LoadBalancer` via `gatewayApi.gateway.serviceType`. Fixes [#250](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/issues/250).
